[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hym Jemuro]] commanded '''a capital ship''' in the [[Eternal Alliance fleet|navy]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]. Several [[Skytrooper]]s, [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] whom had previously been the ground forces of the [[Eternal Empire]] that the Alliance opposed, were stationed on the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], but Jemuro imprisoned them in the cargo hold on the grounds that he believed they were plotting a mutiny. The capital ship was later navigating the [[Kauron asteroid field]] when it suffered critical damage and was repaired by the escaped skytroopers, saving it and the crew.<ref name="CODEX" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hym Jemuro and his ship are first mentioned in "Zakuulan Allies", a codex entry in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'', a [[2016]] expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Site">{{TORweb|url=eternal-throne|text=Knights of the Eternal Throne}}</ref>
